title: Certify actual-start law while retaining the cost of a rare resetting read
statement: For the supplied stationary trigger(q),marker and resetting-read(theta) diagonal-CP family,the true observable norm is|x0-x1|+|x1| independent of q,although the short core inverse grows as1/q. Under one per-primitive abort coin delta,gamma=1-delta,complete adaptive transcript TV from reset is<=U0=[gamma h+gamma^2 l e]/[delta(1+gamma l)+gamma h+gamma^2 l e],l=min(q,q prime),h=|q-q prime|,e=|theta-theta prime|. Uniform rare-normalized-input learning still pays Omega(q^-1 epsilon^-2 log(1/alpha)) primitive calls.

requires: Exactly the supplied trigger/marker/resetting-read family and its calibrated action labels
One global paid abort clock before every attempted primitive
A simultaneous parameter-confidence rectangle;true family structure not inferred from counts
provides: Explicit Bellman coupling of ALL action/outcome/abort transcripts under any common adaptive policy
Rectangle endpoint diameter uses q_L,q_U and theta width;coupling bound need not equal statistical TV
Zero successes in5000 paid reset-trigger trials,alpha=.01,delta=.1 give D0 about.0082174 while normalized state1 bound remains.9
assumptions: Actual-start law does not imply uniform rare-input accuracy
All-input KL<=16qMa^2 because each informative read consumes a successful entry
Same global clock covers future legal reuse;restarting it for unlimited lifetime changes the contract
costs: Every failed trigger,read,marker and start paid;expected native calls<=gamma/delta under that clock
Zero-count guarantee is unconditional return-and-invalid coverage,not confidence conditional on returning zeros
No proof-only state preparation or synthetic q is a learner input
contract.units: Complete stopped classical transcript TV and native primitive calls
contract.obstruction: Avoidable coordinate loss differs from genuine rare-mode information cost. No generic CP learner,physical-memory or ordinary-competitor advantage.

evidence.range_scope: Supplied trigger/marker/resetting-read family:rare-state information lower bound and actual-start globally stopped coupling certificate.
Completed first-return Q52/Q17 family audit with independent Bellman and censored-hazard reconstructions;does not learn the topology.

body: A compatible positive nominal q=0 may discard an unresolved rare mode honestly. It does not certify that rare behavior or change the actual process rank.
